verdict.rationale: Zoho Books documents a full REST API with OpenAPI spec, OAuth2 auth, and claims parity with all web-client operations, which would include ledger/trial-balance style reports, but no evidence explicitly documents a General Ledger or Trial Balance endpoint or its output format. missing for 10: explicit documentation of General Ledger/Trial Balance report endpoints, confirmation of open export formats (CSV/JSON/PDF) for these reports, and independent/hands-on confirmation of pulling these specific reports via API.
